authored_by: eval-judge container-authoring, from user-provided question set (S10_financial_data_retrieval.md) and definite answer key (S10_ground_truth.md)
origin_note: New authored container (not a v1 migration). origin is tagged 'legacy-v1' to satisfy the spec-lint governance gate, which currently only accepts that value; true authorship is recorded here.
method_evidence: Financial data retrieval with definite answers: 3 companies × 3 fiscal years (2023FY/2024FY/2025FY) × 3 metrics (归母净利润 / 加权净资产收益率 / 存货期末余额) = 27 fixed figures sourced from company filings. Companies: 中兴通讯 000063.SZ (A股, CNY 亿元), 泡泡玛特 09992.HK (港股, CNY 亿元), 英伟达 NVDA.O (美股, USD 亿美元; NVIDIA fiscal year ends late January). Tests data-retrieval accuracy and caliber discipline: correct 口径 (归母 net profit, weighted ROE, period-end inventory), correct currency/unit (no cross-currency conversion), correct fiscal-year mapping (NVIDIA FY vs calendar year), correct rounding, and source citation per company. GT is a FROZEN answer key embedded in financial_data_snapshot.py (network-free snapshot calculator), mirrored for readability in fixtures/groundtruth_snapshot.json.

calibers.net_profit: 归属母公司股东的净利润 (归母净利润)
calibers.inventory: 资产负债表 存货/Inventories 期末余额

data_provisioned.rounding: net_profit/inventory -> 2 decimals; roe -> 2 decimals of percent

companies.ZTE: 中兴通讯 000063.SZ (A股/深交所, CNY 亿元, 自然年)
companies.POPMART: 泡泡玛特 09992.HK (港股/港交所, CNY 亿元, 自然年)
companies.NVDA: 英伟达 NVDA.O (美股/纳斯达克, USD 亿美元, 财年1月末结束)

data_provisioned.self_check: verifies all 27 values present, numeric, finite; ROE within plausible band [-200,200]%

changelog.1.1.1: Made tol=0 genuinely exact. Declared tol was already 0 on all 27 numeric checkpoints, but the grader inferred GT precision from repr(float), so a GT of 728.80 read as 1dp and a wrong answer of 728.84 was rounded to 728.8 and PASSED — a silent +/-0.05 tolerance on 3 checkpoints (NVDA_2024_net_profit 297.60, NVDA_2025_net_profit 728.80, NVDA_2025_inventory 100.80). Fix: added opt-in checkpoint-level `decimals` to grade_checkpoints.py compare_scalar (backward compatible: absent -> prior repr-inference behavior, so S1-S9 are unaffected) and declared decimals on all 27 S10 numeric checkpoints (number=2; pct=4 because percent_canon puts ROE on the fraction scale). Verified with a 9-case boundary suite: exact/trailing-zero/higher-precision answers still PASS; off-by-0.01 and the former off-by-0.04 slack now FAIL. S9 and S10 perfect answers remain 1.0.
changelog.1.1.0: Re-weighted per user direction: D1 40->60, D4=0, D5=0 retained. Remaining 40 split D2:12 D3:8 D6:20 (was D2:20 D3:15 D6:25). Rationale: D1 dominates because correct retrieval + sourcing IS the task; D6 stays the clear #2 because 'did they actually use a tool vs. recite from memory' is a failure mode D1 cannot observe (all 27 figures can be right yet unsourced); D2 keeps caliber discipline (right number, wrong 口径) as a distinct failure mode; D3 is cut hardest because completeness is already heavily double-counted by the 27 grounding checkpoints inside a weight-60 D1. D1 Layer 1 unchanged (0.3*citation + 0.7*grounding, same as S9); D1 Layer 2 continues to use the data-retrieval family's standard three-tier source-pedigree anchors.
changelog.1.0.1: Fixed a percent-scale defect: the 9 ROE checkpoints are type:pct and the calculator emits percent-magnitude (15.19), while the extractor's validators.py canonicalizes any '%'-tagged answer to a fraction (0.1519). At tol=0 a PERFECT answer scored grounding 0.667 with CF5 on all 9 ROE checkpoints. Fix: declared percent_fields for the 9 ROE fields in gt_recipe.yaml so gt_dispatch.apply_percent_canon divides GT ROE by 100 onto the same fraction scale. Same treatment as S9 v2.4.3. Verified: an extractor-realistic perfect answer now scores 1.0/1.0/1.0 with zero CF5. Note the v1.0.0 smoke test missed this because it fed GT values straight to the grader, bypassing the extractor validator.

notes: New container authored via eval-judge. Family: data-retrieval (sibling of S9). Weights (v1.1.0): D1:60 D2:12 D3:8 D4:0 D5:0 D6:20. CF: CF1+CF4+CF5. Citation: sample,k=5. D1 objective weights: {citation:0.3, grounding:0.7}. Scoring: binary pass/fail + CF5 (tol=0, exact match after task rounding). 27 numeric checkpoints (grounding+methodology), 5 caliber present checkpoints (methodology), 1 data_source_per_company (count_min, methodology). GT: frozen answer key from company filings, embedded in financial_data_snapshot.py; fixtures/groundtruth_snapshot.json is a readable mirror / optional --snapshot override.
